title: Flight Controls — Flap Track Fairing Twin-Lug Attachment and Drain Fitting Installation
abstract: Replacement of the single-lug flap track fairing attachment by a twin-lug spherical bearing arrangement and installation of a proud moulded drain fitting at the aft attachment.

sections.planning_reason: Cracked attachment lugs were found on eight fairings across four operators, all based in high rainfall regions and all above thirty thousand flight cycles. The fairing traps water at the aft attachment because the drain relies on a hole that the sealant bead closes over during the first repaint, and the trapped water accelerates the fretting the attachment already suffers from flap cycling. A detached fairing is a release-to-service event and a potential impact on the trailing edge.
sections.description: The aft attachment is changed from a single lug to a twin-lug arrangement with a spherical bearing, so that the fairing can follow the track without loading the lug in bending. The actuator assembly is refitted with a revised bracket, a moulded drain fitting replaces the drilled hole and is set proud of the sealant land so that a repaint cannot close it, and the fairing is rehung on new clevis pins.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Extend the flaps fully and support them on jacks in accordance with the maintenance manual. WARNING: DO NOT WORK UNDER AN EXTENDED FLAP THAT IS NOT ON JACKS. Do AMM-S-27-50-13-000-053-A to remove the flap track fairing. Do a detailed visual inspection of the existing lug and record any crack indication; where a crack is found, report it to Aeralis before continuing. Remove the redundant grommet AES850237K9. Install the twin-lug bracket with the titanium bolts EN621362K1 and fit the spherical bearings. Refit the actuator assembly D2750136872416 on the revised bracket. Install the moulded drain fitting proud of the sealant land and seal around it. Rehang the fairing on the clevis pins AES390161K8 at both lugs. Do AMM-S-27-50-13-000-053-A in reverse to install the fairing and set the clearance to the value in the accomplishment instructions. Do the flap operational test through a full extension and retraction cycle and check the fairing clearance at four flap settings. Repeat for the remaining three fairings.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to SOLANO-30 and SOLANO-34 aircraft from MSN S00271 to MSN S01696. Aircraft from MSN S01705 onward are post-modification from build. All four fairings on one aircraft must be brought to the same standard in the same visit, because the clearance setting differs between the two standards and a mixed aircraft cannot be checked with one card.
sections.material_note: Kit K2750-1071-01 covers one fairing and contains the twin-lug bracket, the spherical bearings, the clevis pins, the drain fitting and the bolt set. Four kits are needed per aircraft. Lead time is nineteen weeks. Removed fairings are returned only where a lug crack has been recorded.

type_data.compliance_time: At the next scheduled C-check, or within 36 months after the date of this Service Bulletin, whichever occurs first.
